title: Titan’s Clouds Are More Than Just Methane

scenes.text: Titan’s sky hides a chemical secret unseen on Earth.
People think Titan’s clouds are only simple methane haze.
scenes.label: Methane‑Only Clouds

scenes.text: Cassini‑Huygens revealed that Titan’s clouds also contain complex hydrocarbons like acetylene and ethane, forming dense, layered storms.
scenes.label: Complex Hydrocarbon Clouds

scenes.text: So when you see Titan’s purple veil, you’re looking at a chemical factory in motion.
scenes.label: Chemical Factory

scenes.text: Follow for a new science fact every day.
